system: VerbNet Action×Role typed fiber search + UD dependency-hint frontend (Stanza en_ewt, package "ewt")
compare_to: conmec-typed-fiber-summary.json (legacy positional-heuristic frontend, same protocol, run in the same evaluation session)
interpretation: Replacing chooseActionRoles's positional-offset subject/object heuristic (OpenDomain.hs) with a UD dependency parse (scripts/annotate_dependency_hints.py) raises metonymic F1 by roughly 64% (0.0220 -> 0.0360) and coverage from 40% to 63%, with metonymic precision also improving slightly (0.185 -> 0.197). Both frontends route through the identical compiled Agda runtimeCheck. The gain is smaller than on WiMCor, consistent with ConMeC's broader mix of metonymy categories (container/producer/location/possessed) beyond the location-institution family this frontend change most directly helps. The no-verbnet ablation is again byte-identical to full for both frontends.
